_comment: GOLD, STAGE ONE (#120). Grinding boards to powder is what liberates the metal from the resin
and glass holding it, which is why a smelter can recover it afterwards and could not before.
Pulverizing, not separating: this changes only how fine the material is. The E-Scrap does not
become two things here - a mill does not sort - so there is no scrap-metal byproduct at this
stage. That was in the original plan when the Separator was going to do this job.
Four E-Scrap per powder is the ratio dial (#36 owns the final number). It is deliberately not
one-for-one: gold is trace, and the fiction the whole tier rests on is that e-waste is rich
compared to ore, not that it is free.
